result.summary: B2 READ_ONLY_AUDIT re-ran the B1 fixture gate (valid 12/12 PASS, invalid 30/30 REJECT, baseline PASS, B1 artifact hashes intact). DNA packages immutable. Authority-shaped forbidden fields and additionalProperties close direct_commit paths. Residual adversarial probes found three BLOCKING contract/semantic gaps vs WO fail-closed text: (1) payload_fingerprint excluded by schema while idempotency binding depends on it; same-key different payload both pass without fingerprint; (2) declared polarity not bound to catalog default_polarity enabling peer-peer laundering of directed sockets; (3) adapter_normalization_id not pair-bound. Additional medium notes on material co-requirement and recipe free-form parameters. Findings only; product_writes=[]; accepted=false; next_owner=B3_QA.

findings.title: Idempotency fingerprint field excluded by schema; same-key changed payload passes
findings.statement: WO requires idempotency_key to bind a canonical validated payload fingerprint and reject same-key changed payload. Graph/recipe schemas set additionalProperties:false and do not declare payload_fingerprint, so valid documents cannot carry the binding field. Semantic check only conflicts when payload_fingerprint is present and mismatches. Two in-memory docs with identical idempotency_key and different request_id both PASS with zero errors. INV-29 is rejected (schema additionalProperties on payload_fingerprint plus semantic conflict), so the fixture matrix still greens without proving production-grade key↔fingerprint binding or cross-request store semantics.

reproduction.method: in-memory mutate VALID-01 with same idempotency_key and divergent request_id; validate_document both copies
reproduction.result: BOTH_PASS; schema rejects payload_fingerprint as unexpected additional property

findings.wo_requirement: Idempotency key binds a canonical validated payload fingerprint; identical replay stable; changed payload with same key is conflict
findings.recommended_fix: Add optional-or-required payload_fingerprint (pattern sha256 hex) to both schemas; require fingerprint presence OR document that store-side binding is out of gate scope; add fixture same-key-no-fingerprint residual if in-gate store is not in scope; keep INV-29 semantic conflict after field is schema-legal

findings.title: Declared polarity not bound to socket catalog default_polarity; peer-peer laundering
findings.statement: Semantic polarity_ok only checks output→input or peer→peer pairs of declared polarities. It does not verify declared polarity against socket_catalog.contract.json default_polarity for from_socket/to_socket. Probes: (P2) rewrite first VALID-01 edge to peer/peer → PASS; (P3b) prop_base declared output and terrain_surface declared input with normalization → PASS; (P24) prop_surface/prop_base connected as peer/peer → PASS. This bypasses WO intent that sockets carry explicit polarity with opposite-polarity connections for directed sockets.

reproduction.method: in-memory edge polarity overrides on VALID-01 and synthetic two-node graphs
reproduction.result: PASS for peer-peer laundering and catalog-mismatched declared polarities; REJECT only for input→output

findings.wo_requirement: Sockets carry explicit input/output polarity; connections require opposite polarity and mutual compatibility both directions
findings.recommended_fix: Bind from_polarity/to_polarity to catalog default_polarity (or allow only compatible declared sets); forbid peer on sockets whose default is input/output; add invalid fixtures

findings.title: adapter_normalization_id not pair-bound
findings.statement: For ASYMMETRIC_SOURCE_PAIRS the validator requires some adapter_normalization_id and that the id exists in catalog. It does not require that the normalization's pair equals the edge's socket pair. Probe P12: wall_edge/window_opening with norm_terrain_surface_prop_base_v1 → PASS. Weakens the asymmetric source-audit trail that WO requires for the four DNA one-way relations.

reproduction.method: synthetic wall_edge→window_opening edge with wrong known norm id

findings.wo_requirement: Four asymmetric source relations fail source audit unless normalized explicitly in the adapter contract without rewriting DNA
findings.recommended_fix: When adapter_normalization_id present, require frozenset(norm.pair)==frozenset({from_socket,to_socket}); add INV fixture

findings.title: material_slot and p1e_material_id not co-required
findings.statement: Semantic material check only runs mismatch when both slot and mat present (or unknown slot). material_slot alone PASS; orphan p1e_material_id without slot PASS and is not checked against live_p1e_material_ids when slot is absent. Weakens WO semantic material-slot → P1E mapping explicitness.
findings.recommended_fix: If material_slot present require p1e_material_id matching slot_map; if p1e_material_id present require material_slot and live-set membership

findings.title: Recipe instance parameters accept code-shaped free-form values
findings.statement: build_recipe.schema.json instance.parameters patternProperties allow string|number|boolean|null. Probe with script_body and execute:true PASS. Not executable in this gate, but weakens catalog-only/never-code posture for later adapter consumers if parameters are forwarded unchecked.
findings.recommended_fix: Constrain parameters to allowlisted keys/types or forbid code-like keys; ensure adapter never maps parameters to executable surfaces

findings.title: validation.* flags are non-enforcing
findings.statement: Graph validation.collision/occupancy/sockets/cycle/snap may all be false while semantic_validate_graph still enforces those policies. Not a fail-open of semantics, but flags can mislead consumers.
findings.recommended_fix: Const true on validation flags or ignore flags in docs; optional reject false flags

findings.title: Adapter contract is declarative; no executable world_prompt emission check
findings.statement: world_prompt_adapter.contract.json maps fields and authority_boundary, and partial adapter_proposal checks exist, but validator does not emit/validate a full contracts/world_prompt.schema.json instance. Acceptable for contract-only gate; residual for runtime adapter implementation.
findings.recommended_fix: Future runtime/adapter tests must validate proposal against active world_prompt schema; not blocking if B3/B4 scope remains contract matrix

findings.title: Baseline runtime verifies key files only
findings.statement: source_baseline.lock.json records package tree aggregates, but verify_baseline() only hashes selected manifests/schemas/socket_types/world_prompt. Key-file check PASS; full tree re-aggregate not performed by gate. DNA immutability for this audit confirmed via key manifests matching B0.
findings.recommended_fix: Optional: re-hash tree aggregates in validator or B3 evidence pass
